title: DatasetRef
description: A frozen, versioned dataset that Train and Eval read. Written by the Data service (drafts.py for uploads, freeze.py for the mango pipeline).

task.description: Task spec (tasks/<ref>.json) that renders rows into prompts. Absent on mango-sft, which means mango-qa@v1.

sha256.description: Hash over the split files, in split-name order.

splits.description: Split name to artifact path of a Parquet file. Uploaded datasets use train / validation / test; mango-sft uses train / heldout / heldout_unseen.

split_by.description: How splits were made, e.g. column:split+group:db_id, random, fact+source_doc (mango).

fields.description: The task fields every row carries.

attachments.description: Artifact path of attached files, e.g. one SQLite database per db_id.

validation.description: Checks run at freeze: items checked, invalid, reasons.

source.description: Upload provenance: draft id, file name, rows, edits.

source_docs.description: Mango only: artifact path of the source manifest (Parquet).
